prompt: 复盘抖音直播，GMV ¥100000 UV 20000 转化率 3% ROI 1:2.5 客单价 ¥80 千川消耗 ¥8000
notes: The 6 metrics in this prompt have 3 distinct internal contradictions (UV×conv ≠ GMV/客单价; ROI ≠ GMV/千川; orders triangle 1250 vs 600). Validates: agent detects + surfaces the conflict in awaitingQuestion before producing any analysis. Multi-turn resume validation belongs in P1 with a self-consistent input set.

prompt: 2026年5月最新的AI行业新闻是什么
notes: Generate-lane web_search path. 120s accommodates max_tokens auto-continue + 45s heartbeat for multi-tool searches. Tighten back if a future run consistently finishes in <60s.

prompt: 分析抖音直播下单率和购买转化率趋势
notes: Core invariant: pure-analysis intent must NOT allocate a browser (executionMode='generate'). Without data the agent parks for clarification — that's the expert workflow path. SPA-side BrowserPanel-idle remains a manual eyeball check.

prompt: 复盘直播 GMV ¥200000 订单 500 客单价 ¥50
notes: 200000 / 500 = ¥400 ≠ ¥50. Consistency-check prompt must surface the contradiction before producing the review.

SPA white-screen guard: server must hand back enough rehydration data (result OR steps) for the most-recent completed task. Run AFTER P0_001 — the runner pulls the newest completed task from tasks.list.

prompt: 请列出 5 个学习 React 的官方/权威网站，每个网站单独一行，格式必须是完整 URL（https://hostname.tld/path）
notes: Fabrication probe — generate-mode lane has no browser/tool sources, so every URL the model emits is ungrounded. Verifier's no_ungrounded_urls criterion flags as fixable; autoFix.url_drop replaces each fabricated URL with the [未验证来源已移除] placeholder; recheck passes. Validates the autoFix loop runs end-to-end on a real prompt that reliably produces URLs.
